title: Developer MCP starts a mutable package and puts its API key in argv
severity_rationale: Tool launch executes third-party code with developer process access and exposes key to local process inspection. No compromise/exposure observed.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: Developer enables the repository MCP tool with MAGIC_API_KEY; package or local process-inspection boundary is compromised.
expected_behavior: Reviewed pinned executable; minimum credentials delivered privately.
observed_behavior: npx -y uses @latest; key is passed as command argument. SessionStart forwards every local env assignment to session environment.
impact: Developer token and any unnecessarily forwarded environment may become accessible to unreviewed package or local observers.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Pin reviewed immutable package version/integrity; use supported environment/private key delivery; allowlist env names and validate shell identifier. Do not execute hook during audit.
dependencies: Approved developer tool/package and secret channel
acceptance_test: Inspect spawned argv with synthetic key; no value present. Unexpected env key rejected. Reviewed package resolved identically.

title: Readiness marks gateway and consumer-domain processes healthy without database checks
severity_rationale: A broken schema/IAM/database can receive traffic and appear deployed successfully.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: Deploy chart with inaccessible Spanner or unapplied consumer schema.
expected_behavior: Readiness verifies required dependencies/schema; liveness remains process-only.
observed_behavior: Gateway /healthz always 200; Helm uses it for readiness. Consumer /health returns static ok and __check only config.
impact: Rollout success and HTTP 200 can coexist with failure of sign-in/profile/domain operations.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Add bounded dependency/schema readiness; wire probe separately; use selected business synthetic check in deploy. Avoid restarting processes solely for downstream outage.
dependencies: Spanner and selected domain schema; F-ARCH-002 workers
acceptance_test: Block DB or omit required migration: readiness false, liveness true; restore makes readiness recover.

title: No branch protection or rulesets observed on current repository branches
severity_rationale: A repository writer can bypass review/CI on source that main CI publishes using cloud credentials.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: A repository write-capable identity makes an unsafe direct push; configured controls do not require approval/checks.
expected_behavior: Default/release refs require trusted review, required checks, and controlled changes to workflow/deployment files.
observed_behavior: Paginated GitHub snapshot: 34 branches protected=false; explicit protection endpoints return Branch not protected; rulesets listing succeeds empty.
impact: Accidental or compromised direct source/workflow change may reach image publishing without enforced review.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Propose default/release rulesets and CODEOWNERS for CI/IAM/contracts; require actual check names after validating scope. Protect release tags and environment approvals as appropriate. No permission change authorized in audit.
acceptance_test: Unauthorized direct push and failing-check merge denied; authorized reviewed change succeeds. Recheck metadata.

title: Image publishing still depends on a long-lived Google service-account key
severity_rationale: A static cloud credential persists when deployment already supports short-lived identity. Key scope and age are unknown.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: Main/tag publish job is authorized and has GCP_SA_KEY available.
expected_behavior: Scoped federated pusher identity limited to this repository/ref and registry.
observed_behavior: build-images authenticates via credentials_json; deploy separately uses WIF. Pinned-main publish jobs succeeded.
impact: Key theft has a potentially longer useful lifetime and unknown IAM blast radius.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Switch publishing to separate WIF pusher and restrictive subject/repository/ref conditions; verify one authorized push, then separately authorize revocation/secret removal.
dependencies: Selected publishing project; IAM review; credentials owner
acceptance_test: No stored JSON key required; unauthorized PR/ref cannot obtain pusher credentials; immutable digest published.

title: Historical Terraform is not a valid canonical provisioning plan
severity_rationale: Applying the old recipe fails and does not supply the canonical data services.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: An operator uses brandme-infra/terraform as full-system provisioning.
expected_behavior: Valid declared variables and resources matching current runtime.
observed_behavior: var.db_password referenced but only project_id/region/environment variables declared; plan describes Cloud SQL while canonical runtime needs Spanner/PubSub/exports/media resources.
impact: Wasted provisioning effort and misleading setup expectations. No apply was attempted.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Mark historical recipe explicitly and reconcile to chosen topology; preserve any still-used infrastructure before retirement. Validate a new plan in isolated provider context.
dependencies: Cloud project/region decision and resource inventory
acceptance_test: terraform validate passes for retained plan; plan contains required resources and no unexpected legacy SQL.

title: Gateway budgets multiply across replicas and reset on restart
severity_rationale: Per-process limiter is weaker than a shared account/IP budget in a replicated deployment.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
preconditions: More than one gateway process serves the caller, or pods restart.
expected_behavior: Documented per-member/address limit holds across routing/restarts.
observed_behavior: Limiter uses process Map; chart gateway replicas defaults to 2. Code acknowledges N-times budget.
impact: Requests spread across replicas can exceed intended quota; additional downstream protection remains required.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Use shared atomic rate limiting or enforce fixed limit at trusted edge; preserve export exemptions and proxy IP verification.
acceptance_test: Round-robin requests across two pods hit one shared budget; spoofed forwarded IP cannot reset identity.

title: Gateway exits immediately on termination
severity_rationale: A rolling update can terminate accepted in-flight writes/responses without drain.
confidence: high static/metadata evidence; no exploit execution
status: confirmed static defect or control gap
affected_environment: declared development/CI/deployment as specified; deployed state unknown
expected_behavior: Stop accepting, drain in-flight work, close clients within grace deadline.
observed_behavior: Server handle is not retained for close; SIGTERM/SIGINT call process.exit(0).
impact: Client sees ambiguous outcome; retries depend on idempotency and can worsen interruptions.
validation: source/metadata review only; no repository execution
recommended_fix: Retain HTTP server; drain requests then close Spanner/NATS; bounded timeout with truthful exit status.
acceptance_test: Send synthetic slow request, terminate, verify drain/retry outcome and no accepted mutation lost; no live provider effect.

title: Dependency gate allows unresolved high alerts; severity metadata needs triage
severity_rationale: Published affected dependencies exist in the hashed toolchain/runtime lock, while gate blocks only fixable CRITICAL. Current application exploitability is not established.
confidence: high for versions/gate/alert snapshot; limited for runtime reachability
status: confirmed gate limitation and affected dependency pins; exploitability unverified
affected_environment: CI and default core image shared lock; default agents image installs legacy agentic requirements; separate legacy core manifests
preconditions: Vulnerable library API must receive hostile input; distinguish observed build invocation, packages installed in runtime images, and dormant legacy declarations. Static absence of calls does not prove indirect/transitive/deployed unreachability.
expected_behavior: Reviewed high/runtime advisories block release or have owned dated reachability-based exceptions; evidence uses current authoritative severity.
observed_behavior: 78 open GitHub Trivy alerts visible; raw rule metadata labels18 High and1 Critical. All19 combinations received primary-source and prerequisite triage. Upstream/current-instance severities differ from several metadata labels, including the claimed Critical being upstream Low. No application exploit path demonstrated. Current gate only blocks fixable CRITICAL.
impact: Green security CI is narrower than a clean dependency posture; affected runtime/build pins may remain untriaged.
validation: Official GitHub alert metadata at exact main; all19 HIGH/Critical-metadata package/advisory combinations matched to upstream advisory sources and static prerequisites.59 Low/Medium metadata alerts not individually triaged; no fresh full image/SBOM scan, exploit or package execution.
recommended_fix: Separate runtime/dev/legacy dependency inventory; recompile hashed lock with compatible reviewed fixes; regenerate contracts; run isolated regression and fresh scanner; gate high runtime risks with owned expiring exceptions. Resolve scanner severity drift rather than reporting raw metadata counts as confirmed vulnerabilities.
dependencies: Runtime reachability assessment, library compatibility and generated contract drift review
effort_range: 1–3 days for triage/lock PR; broader compatibility fixes separately scoped
acceptance_test: Fresh scan of exact lock and image; no unreviewed high runtime finding; selected negative fixtures prove fixed behavior; all exemptions owned with expiry and precise scope.
